tagline: Doc-style operating plan: warm off-white page, heavy Inter headlines with tight tracking, pastel-tinted rounded cards, coral circled numbers and Newsreader italic quotes.

palette.description: warm paper, ink text, one coral accent, four pastels with paler tints for cards

typography.style: heavy Inter headlines at minus four percent tracking with Newsreader italic reserved for quotes

best_for: Operating plans and team reviews that want the calm of a well-kept notebook. Status words use fixed green, amber and blue; coral marks one thing per slide.
avoid_for: Loud launches or dark-room keynotes; the page is deliberately quiet.
name: Fieldwork Notes
